messages:
alex: Acme security put the SOW on hold pending CAIQ answers about PrivateLink ownership, VPC flow logs, and log forwarding to their SIEM. Need a pasteable paragraph for the CAIQ field.
mira: Their exact ask: 'Confirm who manages PrivateLink endpoints, VPC flow logs, and whether Redwood will forward logs to our SIEM or retain them.'
samir: Short summary for context: for hosted deployments Redwood manages the control plane and platform network egress and retains infrastructure audit logs per contract. For Dedicated/Private (VPC-connected) deployments the customer provisions and owns VPC endpoints, endpoint policies, VPC flow logs, routing, and local egress controls. Redwood can forward platform audit logs and optional request metadata to customer-managed sinks when configured.
eve: Draft CAIQ paragraph (security posture only): 

"Redwood operates a managed inference control plane. For hosted deployments Redwood manages platform network egress and retains infrastructure audit logs in accordance with the contract. For Dedicated or Private (VPC-connected) deployments, customers provision and manage their VPC endpoints (including AWS PrivateLink), associated endpoint policies, VPC flow logs, and local egress controls. Redwood can, by configuration and with required IAM access, forward platform audit logs and optional request metadata to customer-managed sinks (S3, Kinesis, or SIEM); log forwarding is an optional, SOW-defined integration."

mira: Can we add one sentence about PrivateLink policy ownership?
samir: Add: "When AWS PrivateLink is used the customer retains ownership of the VPC endpoint and its endpoint policy; Redwood will not modify customer endpoint policies and terminates traffic at the configured interface on behalf of the customer."
josh-sales: For the POC note: enabling log-forwarding is an engineering task (roughly 2-4 engineer-days) and may generate ingestion fees depending on volume. Do not include cost estimates in the CAIQ answers.
eve: Agreed. Include the time/cost estimates in the SOW addendum only. CAIQ responses should be posture-focused and neutral.
sec-bot: CAIQ network template: https://redwood.internal/sales/caicq-templates/network (permissions required) :white_check_mark:
alex: We need a single short paragraph to paste into the SIG/CAIQ textbox. Keep it concise.
mira: One-paragraph pasteable: "Redwood provides a managed inference control plane. For hosted deployments Redwood manages platform egress and retains platform audit logs per contract. For Dedicated/Private deployments customers provision and own VPC endpoints (including AWS PrivateLink), VPC flow logs, and local egress controls. Redwood can forward platform audit logs and optional request metadata to customer-managed sinks (S3/Kinesis/SIEM) when configured; forwarding is an optional SOW deliverable."
samir: Suggest adding BYOK note if they select it: "When BYOK is selected customers manage their KMS keys for customer-controlled encryption."
alex: I'll paste this into the CAIQ now and follow up on the SOW addendum for log-forwarding and timeline. If they request endpoint policy examples I'll loop Samir in. Thanks team :thumbsup:
